key_idea: Give every camel 1 hump first. The extra humps belong to the bactrian camels.
steps: Every camel has at least 1 hump. 9 camels give 9 humps.
There are 13 humps. 13 - 9 = 4 humps are left over.
Each bactrian camel has 1 extra hump. So there are 4 bactrian camels.
Check: 4 camels with 2 humps make 8 humps, and 5 camels with 1 hump make 5 humps. 8 + 5 = 13.
